shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل

notes: Two branches joined by «ح»; the names the text writes once after the last «ح» (from «عن عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل») form the shared tail. Each branch ends at its own «سفيان» (the second «حدثنا سفيان» is occurrence 2). «قالوا» joins the three first-level names.
